semiconductor_relevance: High — TEMNEST.INC is directly involved in the semiconductor manufacturing process through its specialized products.
summary: TEMNEST.INC designs, manufactures, and tests Electrostatic Chucks (ESC) for the semiconductor industry, catering to major global semiconductor manufacturers. Their expertise in ceramic coating technology and integrated production system allows them to deliver precision-engineered ESC products that enhance operational efficiency in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Design and manufacturing of Electrostatic Chucks (ESC)
Precision engineering tailored to client specifications

regional_presence.Korea: TEMNEST.INC supplies ESC products to major semiconductor manufacturers such as Samsung and SK-Hynix.
regional_presence.United States: TEMNEST.INC serves key clients like Applied Materials (AMAT) and Lam Research (LAM).
regional_presence.Japan: TEMNEST.INC provides ESC products to Tokyo Electron (TEL).
